title: When We Almost Stopped Climate Change

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: 30 years ago, the United States had a chance to stop climate change.
sentences.zh: 30年前，美国曾有机会阻止气候变化。

sentences.en: Almost nothing stood in the way, except human resistance.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么能挡住去路，除了人性的阻力。

sentences.en: What went wrong?
sentences.zh: 哪里出了问题？

sentences.en: Friday, August 31St.
sentences.zh: 8月31日，星期五。

sentences.en: So by the 1950s, scientists had known for more than half a century that the use of fossil fuels was warming the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 因此，到20世纪50年代，科学家们已经知道使用化石燃料正在使大气变暖半个多世纪了。

sentences.en: But it was only in that decade that scientists started to worry about what that might mean for human society.
sentences.zh: 但正是在那个十年，科学家们才开始担心这可能对人类社会意味着什么。

sentences.en: Nathaniel Rich reported this story for The Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 内撒尼尔·里奇为《泰晤士报杂志》报道了这个故事。

sentences.en: And there were a number of articles published during that time trying to alert the public about the dangers that we were facing.
sentences.zh: 在那期间发表了许多文章，试图提醒公众注意我们正面临的危险。

sentences.en: Even now, man may be unwittingly changing the world's climate through the waste products of his civilization.
sentences.zh: 即使在现在，人类也可能在不知不觉中通过其文明的废弃物改变世界的气候。

sentences.en: Due to our release through factories and automobiles every year of more than 6 billion tons of carbon dioxide, which helps air absorb heat from the sun,
sentences.zh: 由于我们每年通过工厂和汽车排放超过60亿吨的二氧化碳，这有助于空气吸收来自太阳的热量，

sentences.en: our atmosphere seems to be getting warmer.
sentences.zh: 我们的大气层似乎正在变暖。

sentences.en: And although these articles appeared in places like The Times or Time and Life Magazine or on educational programs on primetime TV.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些文章出现在《泰晤士报》或《时代》和《生活》杂志等地方，或出现在黄金时段电视的教育节目中。

sentences.en: A few degrees rise in the Earth's temperature would melt the polar ice caps.
sentences.zh: 地球温度上升几度就会融化极地冰盖。

sentences.en: Not much attention was really paid to it outside of scientific circles for another couple of decades.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几十年里，除了科学界之外，并没有引起太多人的真正关注。

sentences.en: This is Rafe Pomerantz.
sentences.zh: 这是雷夫·庞默兰茨。

sentences.en: Rafe Pomerantz, this political lobbyist and activist for environmental organization,
sentences.zh: 雷夫·庞默兰茨，这位环保组织的政治游说者和活动家，

sentences.en: is sitting in his office on Capitol Hill reading an obscure government report about coal and acid rain when he comes across this paragraph at the end of a chapter.
sentences.zh: 正坐在国会山的办公室里阅读一份关于煤炭和酸雨的晦涩政府报告，当他读到一章末尾的这一段时。

sentences.en: And that section of the report was devoted to the possibility that coal and other fossil fuels would warm the planet through their emissions of carbon dioxide.
sentences.zh: 报告的那一部分专门讨论了煤炭和其他化石燃料通过排放二氧化碳使地球变暖的可能性。

sentences.en: Pomerantz reads all this and is astonished and terrified, but assumes that he must have misread something or that he doesn't understand it.
sentences.zh: 庞默兰茨读完这一切，感到震惊和恐惧，但他认为自己一定看错了什么，或者没有理解它。

sentences.en: And he kind of puts it out of his mind.
sentences.zh: 他有点把这抛到了脑后。

sentences.en: I said to myself, this can't be.
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，这不可能。

sentences.en: It just seemed like a transformation of the planet all in that one sentence.
sentences.zh: 那句话里的内容就像是对地球的一场改造。

sentences.en: A couple days later, however, he comes across an article that interviews Gordon McDonald, who's this prominent government scientist who is warning about the exact same problem.
sentences.zh: 然而几天后，他偶然看到了一篇采访戈登·麦克唐纳的文章，后者是一位杰出的政府科学家，一直在警告完全相同的问题。

sentences.en: And he immediately calls up Gordon McDonald and asks if they can meet.
sentences.zh: 他立即打电话给戈登·麦克唐纳，询问他们是否能见个面。

sentences.en: I said, I'm very curious about this.
sentences.zh: 我说，我对此非常好奇。

sentences.en: I need to know more.
sentences.zh: 我需要了解更多。

sentences.en: And I said, will you see me?
sentences.zh: 我说，你愿意见我吗？

sentences.en: And he said, yes.
sentences.zh: 他说，可以。

sentences.en: So I did.
sentences.zh: 所以我照做了。

sentences.en: So McDonald explains the whole issue to him.
sentences.zh: 于是麦克唐纳向他解释了整个问题。

sentences.en: And Pomerantz says at the end of this long meeting, if I set up briefings for administration officials, people on Capitol Hill, will you do them?
sentences.zh: 在这个长会谈结束时，庞默兰茨说，如果我为行政官员、国会山的人安排简报会，你愿意做吗？

sentences.en: Will you tell them what you just told me?
sentences.zh: 你愿意告诉他们你刚刚对我说的吗？

sentences.en: And he said, yes.
sentences.zh: 他说，可以。

sentences.en: Pomerantz's basic idea was that surely if we communicate this problem to the people who are in power in this country,
sentences.zh: 庞默兰茨的基本想法是，如果我们把这个问题传达给这个国家的当权者，

sentences.en: they will understand the necessity of action and they will do the responsible thing.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定会理解采取行动的必要性，并会做负责任的事情。

sentences.en: So they start having meetings on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始在国会山开会。

sentences.en: They meet with the EPA.
sentences.zh: 他们与环保局会面。

sentences.en: The National Security Council.
sentences.zh: 国家安全委员会。

sentences.en: The State Department.
sentences.zh: 国务院。

sentences.en: Council on Environmental Quality.
sentences.zh: 环境质量委员会。

sentences.en: They meet with the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 他们与《纽约时报》会面。

sentences.en: And Frank Press, who was the president's science advisor.
sentences.zh: 还有总统科学顾问弗兰克·普雷斯。

sentences.en: And after meeting with people from the White House, the White House commissions a report to determine whether the dangers, as Gordon McDonald saw them,
sentences.zh: 在与白宫的人会面后，白宫委托写一份报告，以确定戈登·麦克唐纳眼中的危险，

sentences.en: were accurate and whether action should be taken.
sentences.zh: 是否准确，以及是否应该采取行动。

sentences.en: And a very high level group of scientists gathered in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, in July of 79 and issued a report on the whole problem known as the Charney Report.
sentences.zh: 1979年7月，一高层科学家小组在马萨诸塞州伍兹霍尔聚集，发布了一份关于整个问题的报告，被称为查尼报告。

sentences.en: And that, in a way, formulated the baseline science that, to this day, people look back at.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这奠定了至今人们仍会回溯的基础科学。

sentences.en: Well, I think the Environmental Protection Agency, in many instances, has gone to an extreme.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为环境保护局在许多情况下已经走到了极端。

sentences.en: But Reagan wins the election and Pomerantz realizes that he has to start fighting other battles.
sentences.zh: 但里根赢得了大选，庞默兰茨意识到他必须开始打其他仗。

sentences.en: Reagan appointed the worst possible people to the key agencies.
sentences.zh: 里根向关键机构任命了最糟糕的人选。

sentences.en: And Gorsuch at EPA, Jim Watt at Interior.
sentences.zh: 环保局的戈苏奇，内政部的吉姆·瓦特。

sentences.en: There's a very anti-environmental crowd, about as anti-environmental as you could ask for.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常反环保的人群，几乎达到了你能要求的反环保极限。

sentences.en: We've got environmentalists who wouldn't let you build a house unless it looked like a bird's neSt.
sentences.zh: 我们有这样的环保主义者：除非你的房子看起来像鸟巢，否则他们绝不让你盖。

sentences.en: And they must be restrained.
sentences.zh: 必须限制他们。

sentences.en: The climate issue basically goes off the map.
sentences.zh: 气候问题基本上从版图上消失了。

sentences.en: And Pomerantz doesn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 庞默兰茨不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: I think right now, the biggest help the federal government could be would be to get out with some of its regulations.
sentences.zh: 我想现在联邦政府能提供的最大帮助就是废除一些规章制度。

sentences.en: As Reagan tries to roll everything back, essentially, to Teddy Roosevelt's administration.
sentences.zh: 当里根试图把一切基本上都倒退回西奥多·罗斯福政府时期时。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember in a meeting in 1980, shortly after the election, I was sitting in a meeting of my environmental colleagues.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得在1980年选举后不久的一次会议上，我坐在环保同事的会议中。

sentences.en: I said, we're finished.
sentences.zh: 我说，我们完蛋了。

sentences.en: You know, this is disaster.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一场灾难。

sentences.en: This is a site which is very familiar to all of us.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们都非常熟悉的地点。

sentences.en: Shells full of aerosol cans containing a whole variety of products.
sentences.zh: 装满各种产品的气雾罐外壳。

sentences.en: Two chemists recognized that these very unreactive compounds accumulate in the atmosphere and could lead to a decrease in the amount of ozone in the stratosphere.
sentences.zh: 两位化学家认识到，这些极不活泼的化合物会在大气中积聚，并可能导致平流层中臭氧量的减少。

sentences.en: But in 1985, there's a major study published by a bunch of British scientists who have observed that the level of ozone above the Antarctic has dramatically declined.
sentences.zh: 但在1985年，一群英国科学家发表了一项重大研究，他们观察到南极上空的臭氧水平急剧下降。

sentences.en: Recently, scientists discovered a weak spot in the ozone layer over Antarctica, the icy continent at the South Pole.
sentences.zh: 最近，科学家们在南极洲（南极的冰冷大陆）上空的臭氧层中发现了一个弱点。

sentences.en: There it was, this huge hole the size of North America over Antarctica.
sentences.zh: 它就在那里，南极上空有一个北美洲大小的巨大空洞。

sentences.en: They say increased ultraviolet radiation through a hole in the ozone could raise temperatures, damage farm crops, and cause a lot more sunburn.
sentences.zh: 他们说，通过臭氧空洞增加的紫外线辐射可能会升高温度、破坏农作物，并导致更多的晒伤。

sentences.en: And almost overnight, there is an enormous amount of public panic about what this might mean.
sentences.zh: 几乎一夜之间，公众对这可能意味着什么产生了巨大的恐慌。

sentences.en: Yeah, the ozone hole had a powerful effect on the public.
sentences.zh: 是的，臭氧空洞对公众产生了强大的影响。

sentences.en: Even though it was a different kind of event in the atmosphere, it made it believable that human beings could alter things on a global scale.
sentences.zh: 尽管它是大气中另一种事件，但它让人相信人类可以在全球范围内改变事物。

sentences.en: The most popular theory is that man-made chemicals, chlorofluorocarbons, known as CFCs, are causing the problem.
sentences.zh: 最流行的理论是人造化学物质氟氯化碳（即CFCs）正在引发这个问题。

sentences.en: Now, with an eye on what's happening over Antarctica, some scientists want a worldwide ban on all uses of CFCs.
sentences.zh: 现在，着眼于南极上空发生的事情，一些科学家希望在全球范围内禁止所有CFC的使用。

sentences.en: And by 1987, you have the Montreal Protocol, which is the first global atmospheric environmental treaty.
sentences.zh: 到1987年，你有了《蒙特利尔议定书》，这是第一个全球大气环境保护条约。

sentences.en: And it becomes a template for a possible global warming solution.
sentences.zh: 它成为了可能的全球变暖解决方案的模板。

sentences.en: By asking whether together we could mobilize the political will, specifically,
sentences.zh: 通过询问我们是否能共同调动政治意愿，特别是，

sentences.en: notice has been served to all concern that products and technologies that threaten the Earth's sun shield are no longer acceptable.
sentences.zh: 已向所有相关方发出通知，威胁地球防晒盾的产品和技术不再被接受。

sentences.en: So, the ozone hole kind of opened the door to the credibility, in a certain way, of the climate problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，臭氧空洞为气候问题的可信度打开了一扇门。

sentences.en: Well, Steve Newman is standing by now to fill us in on what went on weather-wise today.
sentences.zh: 现在史蒂夫·纽曼正准备向我们通报今天的天气情况。

sentences.en: And I can tell you this one thing.
sentences.zh: 我能告诉你这一件事。

sentences.en: We set a brand new record, which may never be broken again.
sentences.zh: 我们创下了一个可能永远不会被打破的新纪录。

sentences.en: And then we get to the summer of 1988.
sentences.zh: 然后我们来到了1988年夏天。

sentences.en: June 1988, global temperatures for the first five months of the year were the warmest ever recorded.
sentences.zh: 1988年6月，该年前五个月的全球气温是有记录以来最暖的。

sentences.en: The hottest summer in recorded history.
sentences.zh: 有记录以来最热的夏天。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: It wasn't even noon today when the temperature at Sioux Falls in South Dakota was over 100.
sentences.zh: 今天甚至还没到中午，南达科他州苏福尔斯的温度就超过了100华氏度。

sentences.en: How many days has it been 100 this year?
sentences.zh: 今年已经有多少天达到100华氏度了？

sentences.en: In Georgia, a woman died from heat stroke while she was working in a tobacco field.
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州，一名女性在烟草田工作时死于中暑。

sentences.en: This was our 15th day since Memorial Day with temperatures of 90 degrees or better.
sentences.zh: 这是自阵亡将士纪念日以来我们经历的第15天气温达到或超过90华氏度的日子。

sentences.en: If the air is so thick you can see it, it should be no surprise you can also feel it.
sentences.zh: 如果空气浓稠得肉眼可见，那么你能感觉得到也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: And we could be heading for new records over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 周末我们可能会迎来新的纪录。

sentences.en: A third straight day at record high temperatures sent heat waves shimmering across the area.
sentences.zh: 连续第三天创纪录的高温让热浪在整个地区闪烁。

sentences.en: You have incredible drought across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国各地都遭遇了难以置信的干旱。

sentences.en: Severe drought conditions caused half of the nation's agricultural counties to be declared disaster areas.
sentences.zh: 严重的干旱状况导致全国一半的农业县被宣布为灾区。

sentences.en: Well, it's the worst I've seen it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我见过的最糟情况。

sentences.en: It's the worst my father has seen it.
sentences.zh: 这是我父亲见过的最糟情况。

sentences.en: He's 76 years old.
sentences.zh: 他76岁了。

sentences.en: You have headlines all summer long that are apocalyptic.
sentences.zh: 整个夏天你都能看到末日般的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Where some people have become so distraught they have told their congressman, God is against us.
sentences.zh: 有些人变得如此心烦意乱，以至于他们告诉国会议员，上帝在反对我们。

sentences.en: Washington was having unusually hot weather too.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的天气也异常炎热。

sentences.en: All of that tended to focus attention on a hearing here on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都倾向于将人们的注意力集中在国会山的一场听证会上。

sentences.en: So at the height of this summer, in June, there's set to be a hearing before the Senate about global warming.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个夏天的顶峰，即6月，参议院将举行一场关于全球变暖的听证会。

sentences.en: And the night before the hearing, Pomerantz gets a phone call from the lead witness, a NASA scientist named James Hansen.
sentences.zh: 在听证会的前一天晚上，庞默兰茨接到主证人的电话，这是一位名叫詹姆斯·汉森的美国宇航局科学家。

sentences.en: And Hansen tells him, tomorrow at this hearing, I'm going to make a major statement.
sentences.zh: 汉森告诉他，明天在这个听证会上，我将发表一项重大声明。

sentences.en: We have a number of senators here, and we might move very rapidly into questions.
sentences.zh: 我们这里有许多参议员，我们可能会很快进入提问环节。

sentences.en: Let me just first of all ask a short one of you, Dr. Hansen, and then ask others to comment if they would like.
sentences.zh: 首先让我向你简单提问，汉森博士，然后如果愿意的话请其他人发表评论。

sentences.en: I think the question that everybody's asking today with all of the heat and everything going on across the Middle West and the Southwest and so on is,
sentences.zh: 我想今天每个人在面对中西部和西南部等地的所有酷暑及其他情况时都在问的问题是，

sentences.en: is the current heat wave and drought related to the greenhouse effect?
sentences.zh: 当前的热浪和干旱与温室效应有关吗？

sentences.en: The global warming is now large enough that we can ascribe with a high degree of confidence, a cause and effect relationship to the greenhouse effect.
sentences.zh: 全球变暖现在已经足够大，我们可以以高度的自信将因果关系归结为温室效应。

sentences.en: The signal has emerged.
sentences.zh: 信号已经出现。

sentences.en: The temperature of the planet is telling us that climate change, the greenhouse effect, is underway.
sentences.zh: 地球的温度在告诉我们，气候变化、温室效应正在发生。

sentences.en: We are now seeing the effect of what we predicted years ago.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正在看到多年前我们预测的效果。

sentences.en: It's no longer theory.
sentences.zh: 这不再是理论。

sentences.en: It's happening now.
sentences.zh: 它正在发生。

sentences.en: And afterwards, in a press conference, he says it's time to stop waffling and it's time to take action.
sentences.zh: 随后在一次新闻发布会上，他说现在是停止骑墙观望、采取行动的时候了。

sentences.en: The scientist was Dr. James Hansen, director of the Goddard Institute for Space Studies in New York City.
sentences.zh: 这位科学家是詹姆斯·汉森博士，纽约市戈达德太空研究所所长。

sentences.en: He told a Senate committee the warming trend of the 1980s, which included the five hottest years on record, was not normal, not a natural climate variation.
sentences.zh: 他在一个参议院委员会上表示，20世纪80年代的变暖趋势（包括有记录以来最热的五年）是不正常的，不是自然的气候变化。

sentences.en: This seems like a dramatic moment along the lines of there's now a hole in the ozone.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一个戏剧性的时刻，类似于现在有了一个臭氧空洞。

sentences.en: There is now evidence that global warming is happening now.
sentences.zh: 现在有证据表明全球变暖正在发生。

sentences.en: Yes, it's a perfect corollary to there's a hole in the ozone layer.
sentences.zh: 是的，这与臭氧层有个空洞完美呼应。

sentences.en: And it has a major effect.
sentences.zh: 它产生了重大影响。

sentences.en: There are dozens and dozens of headlines across the country the week of the hearing.
sentences.zh: 听证会那一周，全国各地出现了成百上千个头条新闻。

sentences.en: The consensus in favor of taking action has been building, slowly and haltingly.
sentences.zh: 支持采取行动的共识一直在缓慢而步履维艰地建立起来。

sentences.en: Hansen becomes overnight a kind of celebrity, the face of the global warming problem.
sentences.zh: 汉森一夜之间成为某种名人，成为全球变暖问题的代言人。

sentences.en: The Congress is considering legislation to coordinate and strengthen U.S.
sentences.zh: 国会正在审议旨在协调和加强美国关于该问题的政策的立法。

sentences.en: policy with regard to the problem.
sentences.zh: 政策。

sentences.en: By the end of 1988, there are 32 climate bills.
sentences.zh: 到1988年底，有32项气候法案。

sentences.en: The environment minister agrees Canadians must get ready for a warmer globe.
sentences.zh: 环境部长同意加拿大人必须为一个更暖的地球做好准备。

sentences.en: But he's also pushing for an international agreement that would control carbon dioxide emissions.
sentences.zh: 但他也在推动一项能够控制二氧化碳排放的国际协议。

sentences.en: And a process begins in earnest to formulate a global treaty to prevent catastrophic global warming.
sentences.zh: 旨在制定一项防止灾难性全球变暖的全球条约的进程正式开始。

sentences.en: The idea is to convince everyone that all of this isn't just scientific speculation.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是说服每个人，所有这一切不仅仅是科学推测。

sentences.en: It's real and it's cause for great concern.
sentences.zh: 它是真实的，并且是高度关注的理由。

sentences.en: So at this point, Pomerantz is feeling pretty good.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，庞默兰茨感觉相当不错。

sentences.en: I think we were feeling like we were making progress.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时觉得自己正在取得进展。

sentences.en: 1988 was also an election year.
sentences.zh: 1988年也是一个选举年。

sentences.en: Today, I'd like to begin to outline what I do about the environment.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想开始概述我对环境的看法。

sentences.en: My plan for how we as a nation and as a people can lead the world to a new recognition of the importance of the environment.
sentences.zh: 我的计划是关于我们作为一个国家和一个民族如何能够引领世界对环境重要性有新的认识。

sentences.en: And so George H.W.
sentences.zh: 因此，老布什

sentences.en: Bush campaigns on the issue.
sentences.zh: 布什以此作为竞选议题。

sentences.en: Some say these problems are too big, that it's impossible for an individual or even a nation as great as ours to solve the problem of global warming.
sentences.zh: 有人说这些问题太严重了，个人甚至像我们这样伟大的国家，也根本不可能解决全球变暖的问题。

sentences.en: He says it can be done and we must do it.
sentences.zh: 他说这件事能办到，而且我们必须去做。

sentences.en: It means we're going to do something about the problem.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们要采取行动解决这个问题。

sentences.en: The White House will do something about the problem.
sentences.zh: 白宫将采取行动解决这个问题。

sentences.en: From NBC News Election Headquarters, this is Election Night 88.
sentences.zh: 这里是NBC新闻选举总部，我是88选举之夜。

sentences.en: So George H.W.
sentences.zh: 因此，老乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush gets elected and industry starts to brace for new regulatory policy or even climate legislation.
sentences.zh: 布什当选后，各行各业开始为新的监管政策甚至气候立法做准备。

sentences.en: But shortly after he enters office, there emerges a very strong divide between different factions within the White House.
sentences.zh: 但在他上任后不久，白宫内部的不同派系之间出现了非常严重的严重分歧。

sentences.en: On one side, the EPA administrator and the Secretary of State, who are pushing strongly for a global treaty.
sentences.zh: 一方面是环保局局长和国务卿，他们极力推动达成全球条约。

sentences.en: And on the other side, John Sununu, Chief of Staff, who's deeply skeptical of the science and of any efforts to introduce regulatory policy related to climate.
sentences.zh: 另一方面是幕僚长约翰·苏努努，他深切怀疑科学以及任何旨在引入与气候相关的监管政策的努力。

sentences.en: And Sununu became basically a difficult obstacle to moving forward.
sentences.zh: 苏努努基本上成了推进工作的一个艰难障碍。

sentences.en: So in response to this internal back and forth conflict within the White House,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了应对白宫内部这种来回拉锯的冲突，

sentences.en: Al Gore decides to hold another hearing again with James Hansen to put pressure on the White House to commit fully to the global negotiation process for a treaty.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·戈尔决定再次与詹姆斯·汉森举行听证会，向白宫施压，要求其全力投入条约的全球谈判进程。

sentences.en: So as usual, James Hansen sends his prepared testimony to the White House for approval.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，詹姆斯·汉森将他准备好的证词提交给白宫审批。

sentences.en: But this time it comes back heavily censored with all kinds of deletions that distort his scientific findings and also additions that make arguments about economic policy,
sentences.zh: 但这次送回来时被大肆删改，删除了各种歪曲他科学发现的内容，还增添了关于经济政策的论点，

sentences.en: essentially saying that there should be no regulations that at all compromise the economic goals of the country.
sentences.zh: 实质上是说不应该有任何会危及国家经济目标的监管规定。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So Hansen, rather than fighting with the White House censors, he accepts all of the changes, but then he makes a call to Gore and tells him what's happened.
sentences.zh: 因此，汉森没有与白宫的审查人员对抗，而是接受了所有的修改，但他随后给戈尔打了电话，告诉他发生了什么。

sentences.en: Gore asks Hansen, can I tell this to the New York Times?
sentences.zh: 戈尔问汉森，我能把这件事告诉《纽约时报》吗？

sentences.en: And Hansen says, sure.
sentences.zh: 汉森说，当然可以。

sentences.en: And the Times publishes a bombshell story saying that the White House is trying to censor a NASA scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 于是《时报》发表了一篇重磅报道，称白宫正试图审查一位美国宇航局科学家。

sentences.en: The administration censored testimony by Dr. Hansen to make his conclusions seem less serious and less certain.
sentences.zh: 政府审查了汉森博士的证词，使其结论显得不那么严重、也不那么确定。

sentences.en: So it's a huge embarrassment to the White House and they have to apologize.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对白宫来说是一场巨大的难堪，他们不得不道歉。

sentences.en: They claim that the censorship came from a functionary five levels down from the top.
sentences.zh: 他们声称审查来自距离最高层五级之下的一个办事员。

sentences.en: And they shortly thereafter recommit to the international negotiation process for a climate treaty.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，他们重新承诺参与气候条约的国际谈判进程。

sentences.en: And they say, furthermore, that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们还说，此外，美国

sentences.en: will lead the effort.
sentences.zh: 将领导这一努力。

sentences.en: And who was that anonymous censor to Hansen, anyway, behind the deletions and the additions?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，汉森背后那些增删内容的匿名审查员究竟是谁？

sentences.en: So nobody knew who this censor was at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以在当时，没有人知道这个审查员是谁。

sentences.en: But when I asked John Stenunu about this during my reporting, he said that the directive had come from him.
sentences.zh: 但当我做报道时向约翰·苏努努询问此事时，他说指令是他下达的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We need action and we need it now.
sentences.zh: 我们需要行动，而且刻不容缓。

sentences.en: Every American deserves to breathe clean air.
sentences.zh: 每个美国人都理应呼吸到清新的空气。

sentences.en: So in November, there's a meeting in Nordvijk in the Netherlands, which will be the first high-level diplomatic meeting about the framework for a global treaty on climate change.
sentences.zh: 因此，11月在荷兰诺德韦克举行了一场会议，这将是关于全球气候变化条约框架的第一场高级别外交会议。

sentences.en: Every country sends its environmental minister.
sentences.zh: 每个国家都派出了环境部长。

sentences.en: So the U.S.'s equivalent is the head of the EPA, William Riley, who's the strongest proponent of a treaty in the White House.
sentences.zh: 因此，相当于美国代表的是环保局局长威廉·雷利，他是白宫里条约最坚定的支持者。

sentences.en: But Stenunu doesn't trust him, so he sends an ally as a kind of minder to make sure that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但苏努努不信任他，于是派了一个盟友作为某种监督员，确保美国

sentences.en: doesn't accept any kind of binding proposal.
sentences.zh: 不会接受任何形式的具有约束力的提案。

sentences.en: There were a group of us advocates who were there.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有一群倡导者也在那里。

sentences.en: On the last day, there's a major session that's closed to everyone except for the diplomats.
sentences.zh: 在最后一天，有一场重要会议，除了外交官之外，不对任何人开放。

sentences.en: And Pomerantz and his fellow activists camp out outside of the big conference room at a hotel where this is taking place.
sentences.zh: 波兰茨和他的活动家同伴们露营在举行会议的酒店的大会议室外面。

sentences.en: We were there to bring attention to the success or failure of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里是为了引起人们对会议成功与否的关注。

sentences.en: And they wait as the meeting goes longer than expected, deep into the night and finally into the next morning.
sentences.zh: 会议比预期持续了更长时间，一直持续到深夜，最后到了第二天早晨，他们一直在等待。

sentences.en: And we'd try to find out what was going on, try to bring some attention to the meeting, to the media, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 我们试图弄清楚发生了什么，试图让媒体关注这场会议，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And finally, in the early hours, the Swedish minister emerges and they ask him, what's happening?
sentences.zh: 最后，在清晨时分，瑞典部长走了出来，他们问他，发生什么事了？

sentences.en: And he says, your country is fucking this thing up.
sentences.zh: 他说，你们国家把这事搞砸了。

sentences.en: The U.S., led by Alan Bromley, Stenunu's guy, has refused to endorse any global treaty that has any hard targets or demands any specific emissions reductions.
sentences.zh: 在苏努努的心腹艾伦·布罗姆利领导下，美国拒绝签署任何设定硬性目标或要求具体减排的全球条约。

sentences.en: And with that, the best opportunity that we've had for a binding global treaty to prevent climate change falls apart.
sentences.zh: 随着这一情况，我们为防止气候变化而达成的具有约束力的全球条约的最佳机会破灭了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Nathaniel, what went wrong here?
sentences.zh: 内森尼尔，这里到底出了什么问题？

sentences.en: How do you understand the Bush administration's opposition to participating in something that the entire scientific community,
sentences.zh: 你怎么理解布什政府反对参与这样一件事，而整个科学界

sentences.en: as well as the vast majority of the rest of the world, agree is an existential threat to all of us that has to be addressed by all of us?
sentences.zh: 以及绝大多数世界其他地方都认为这是对我们所有人的生存威胁，必须由我们所有人共同解决？

sentences.en: Well, there's a simple political explanation, which is that the chief of staff, Johnson Nunu, won this political fight within the White House.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一个简单的政治解释，那就是幕僚长约翰·苏努努赢得了白宫内部的这场政治斗争。

sentences.en: But I think you can also ask, well,
sentences.zh: 但我想你也可以问，嗯，

sentences.en: why was the level of support of the political and public support for solving the problem not strong enough to overcome the will of one man who wasn't even the president?
sentences.zh: 为什么解决问题的政治和公众支持水平不足以克服一个甚至都不是总统的人的意志？

sentences.en: And I think that leads you into some larger questions about our ability to grapple meaningfully with a problem of such enormous stakes and the problem of those ramifications wouldn't be felt for decades or even generations.
sentences.zh: 我想这会引导你思考一些更宏大的问题，关于我们是否有能力认真应对一个风险如此巨大、且其后果要在几十年甚至几代人之后才会显现的问题。

sentences.en: We talk about the effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论气候变化的影响。

sentences.en: We're talking about civilizational death.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是文明的灭绝。

sentences.en: And I don't think we like looking at that in the face.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们敢直视这一点。

sentences.en: And so we do whatever we can not do.
sentences.zh: 所以我们竭尽所能不去面对。

sentences.en: Our responsibility is to maintain the quality of our approach, our commitment to sound science and an open mind to policy options.
sentences.zh: 我们的责任是保持方法的质量，坚持严谨的科学，并对政策选项保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: By 1990, Bush's entire economic council comes out against climate policy.
sentences.zh: 到1990年，布什的整个经济委员会都站出来反对气候政策。

sentences.en: At the same time.
sentences.zh: 与此同时。

sentences.en: ExxonMobil has long been criticized for allegedly hiding what it knew about climate change.
sentences.zh: 埃克森美孚长期以来一直因涉嫌隐瞒其对气候变化的了解而受到批评。

sentences.en: Just today, a pair of researchers say that Exxon's own documents prove that is true.
sentences.zh: 就在今天，几位研究人员表示，埃克森自己的文件证明了这一点。

sentences.en: The oil and gas industry mobilizes on the issue and develops a strategy and a campaign of funding disinformation propaganda.
sentences.zh: 石油和天然气行业围绕这一议题展开动员，制定了战略，并发起了资助虚假信息的宣传运动。

sentences.en: To assess ExxonMobil's public statements, it cast doubt on whether climate change was real, it discounted human impacts,
sentences.zh: 为了评估埃克森美孚的公开言论，它对气候变化是否真实表示怀疑，淡化了人类的影响，

sentences.en: and they suggested there was nothing practical to do about it anyway.
sentences.zh: 并且他们暗示反正对此也无能为力。

sentences.en: Paying off scientists and politicians and ultimately the entire Republican Party to embrace this notion of uncertainty in the science.
sentences.zh: 收买科学家和政治家，并最终让整个共和党接受科学中存在不确定性的这种观念。

sentences.en: Are you convinced that climate change is man-made?
sentences.zh: 你确信气候变化是人为造成的吗？

sentences.en: Well, look, I don't know that that is a resolved issue in science today.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听着，我不知道这在当今科学界是否是一个已经解决的问题。

sentences.en: And ultimately to deny the existence of climate change altogether.
sentences.zh: 并最终彻底否认气候存在的现实。

sentences.en: We keep hearing that 2014 has been the warmest year on record.
sentences.zh: 我们不断听到2014年是有记录以来最热的一年。

sentences.zh: 我问主席，你知道这是什么吗？

sentences.en: And that's just from outside here.
sentences.zh: 这只是从外面拿进来的。

sentences.en: Very unseasonal.
sentences.zh: 非常不合时节。

sentences.en: So here, Mr. President, catch this.
sentences.zh: 所以，总统先生，接着这个。

sentences.en: I don't buy that, Joe.
sentences.zh: 我不买账，乔。

sentences.zh: 你这话什么意思，你不买账？

sentences.en: I just don't buy the fact that it's a crisis.
sentences.zh: 我就是不相信这是一场危机。

sentences.en: So Obama's talking about all of this with the global warming and a lot of it's a hoax.
sentences.zh: 所以奥巴马谈论所有这些全球变暖的事情，很多都是个骗局。

sentences.en: It's a hoax.
sentences.zh: 是个骗局。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a money-making industry, okay?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个赚钱的行业，好吧？

sentences.en: As a result of industry's efforts, the politics around the issue become sharply divided.
sentences.zh: 由于行业的努力，围绕这个议题的政治变得严重对立。

sentences.en: For those who believe this, it would have to be dealt with on a worldwide basis.
sentences.zh: 对于那些相信这一点的人来说，必须在全球范围内应对。

sentences.en: So let's take a look at that.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们来看看这一点。

sentences.en: Even if you believe that that is a serious problem that needs to be addressed, one country doing it is going to have no impact.
sentences.zh: 即使你认为这是一个需要解决的严重问题，单靠一个国家去这样做也将毫无影响。

sentences.en: Why has it taken so long, Senator, for—

sentences.zh: 这是特殊利益。

sentences.zh: 是公用事业公司、石油公司和其他特殊利益集团。

sentences.en: They're the ones that have blocked progress in the Congress of the United States and in the administration.
sentences.zh: 正是他们在美国国会和政府中阻碍了进展。

sentences.en: At the same time, the seas continue to rise and natural disasters continue to occur at increasing frequency.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，海平面继续上升，自然灾害继续以越来越高的频率发生。

sentences.zh: 这不是一个好消息的故事。

sentences.zh: 气温还在不断变暖。

sentences.zh: 超过5000万美国人处于极端高温预警之下，而且这种天气短期内不会结束。

sentences.zh: 牧场大火已经吞噬了35.1万英亩土地，成为该州历史上最大的野火。

sentences.en: Excessive heat is also a threat thousands of miles away in Europe.
sentences.zh: 数千英里之外的欧洲也面临着极端高温的威胁。

sentences.en: In Lisbon, Portugal, mercury peaked at 111 degrees.
sentences.zh: 在葡萄牙里斯本，气温峰值达到111华氏度。

sentences.en: The highest temperature ever measured in Britain was recorded at Heathrow Airport this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 今天下午，英国测得的有史以来最高气温在希思罗机场记录下来。

sentences.en: It reached 37.9 degrees Celsius or more than 100 Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 气温达到了37.9摄氏度，即超过100华氏度。

sentences.en: And in Frankfurt, Germany, the thermometer reached 97.
sentences.zh: 在德国法兰克福，温度计达到了97度。

sentences.en: Japan is fighting back against a heat wave that is striking many parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 日本正在奋力抗击袭击该国许多地区的热浪。

sentences.en: Famine threatened Somalia for the second time this decade.
sentences.zh: 索马里在这十年中第二次面临饥荒的威胁。

sentences.en: It feels like this decade that you examine, 1979 to 89, is this moment when everybody is willing to meet from all these industries and all these advocacy groups.
sentences.zh: 感觉你所审视的这十年，即1979年至1989年，是一个所有这些行业和所有这些倡导团体

sentences.en: And the government and to talk about this without yet becoming so entrenched in their positions and in their self-intereSt.
sentences.zh: 以及政府都愿意聚在一起讨论这个问题，而尚未深陷各自立场和自私利益的时期。

sentences.en: Even though those things all begin to rear their heads.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些事情都开始崭露头角。

sentences.en: When this was actually still about the science for a moment.
sentences.zh: 当这一切暂时还真正关乎科学时。

sentences.en: And that after this decade, everything would become so much harder.
sentences.zh: 并且在这十年之后，一切都变得困难得多。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I think you were still in the window at which a relatively gradual intervention would have had major positive benefits.
sentences.zh: 我认为当时仍然处于一个相对渐进的干预就能带来重大积极效益的窗口期。

sentences.en: And maybe it takes a couple decades to get right, but it would have been enough.
sentences.zh: 也许需要几十年才能做好，但这就足够了。

sentences.en: Now that's not enough.
sentences.zh: 现在这已经不够了。

sentences.en: That window is closed.
sentences.zh: 那个窗口已经关闭了。

sentences.en: But it's not too late.
sentences.zh: 但现在还不算太晚。

sentences.en: There are plans out there that present a pretty clear path towards solving this and keeping global temperatures under two degrees Celsius rise.
sentences.zh: 有一些计划提出了一个相当清晰的途径，可以解决这个问题，并把全球气温升幅控制在摄氏两度以下。

sentences.en: But what's lacking is the political will to achieve the kind of transformation of our energy system and really of the global economy that's required to do this.
sentences.zh: 但缺乏的是实现这种能源系统变革以及真正实现完成此任务所需的全球经济变革的政治意愿。

sentences.en: And I don't think we're going to muster up that level of political will until we understand the issue in moral terMs.
sentences.zh: 我认为，在我们从道德层面理解这个问题之前，我们是不会凝聚起那种水平的政治意愿的。

sentences.en: And until everybody or most people feel some sense of moral obligation to demand action.
sentences.zh: 直到每个人或大多数人感受到某种要求采取行动的道德义务。

sentences.en: Nathaniel, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 内森尼尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们不胜感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。
